introH2: What kinds of hotels are near Suvarnabhumi Airport — and how do you pick the right one for your flight situation?
introHtml:
Suvarnabhumi Airport (IATA: BKK) sits on Bangkok's eastern edge in the Lat Krabang–Racha Thewa corridor, roughly 25–30 km from the city centre. That distance forces every traveller with an early departure or late arrival into the same recurring question: pay a premium to sleep steps from the terminal, or save money with a hotel a few kilometres out and rely on a free shuttle?

The good news is that the options near Suvarnabhumi span almost every budget and need. There is an on-airport 5-star where you walk through an underground tunnel to the departure hall. There is a brand-new Marriott 3 km away that opened in late 2023. Several well-reviewed 4-star hotels cluster around Lat Krabang and Racha Thewa, most with hourly free shuttles. And there are solid 3-star choices with pools, free breakfast and parking from 900 THB a night.

This guide covers 7 hotels we have reviewed in depth. For each one we spell out whether the airport shuttle is free or paid, exactly when it runs, how far the hotel is from the terminal, and what real guests say about the experience. Prices are compared across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com with direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Suvarnabhumi Airport (IATA: BKK) is located in Bang Phli district, Samut Prakan province. The Airport Rail Link (ARL) departs from the basement of the terminal and reaches Phaya Thai (where you can transfer to the BTS Skytrain Sukhumvit line) in approximately 30 minutes, stopping at Lat Krabang along the way. Hotels in this guide fall into two clusters: Lat Krabang zone (~3 km from the airport — Hyatt Regency inside the terminal, The Park Nine, Courtyard Marriott), which is also closest to Lat Krabang ARL station; and Racha Thewa–Bang Phli zone (~7–11 km — Siam Mandarina, Best Western Amaranth, Sinsuvarn, Cozy Blu). All seven properties offer an airport shuttle, but the terms differ significantly — read each entry carefully before booking.

entries.storyHtml: Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport is the airport's one official hotel — physically inside the terminal complex, linked to the departures hall by a 300-metre underground tunnel, with a free shuttle running all day for guests who prefer the ride. The two things transit passengers and pre-dawn flyers consistently praise are flexible 24-hour check-in/out and a breakfast restaurant that opens at 3 AM — meaning you can eat a full meal before any flight, however early. The honest caveat: the building dates from 2006 and some rooms are showing their age, with occasional reports of musty odour or worn fixtures, and rates run noticeably higher than any off-airport rival. It earns the top spot purely on proximity advantage — nothing else in this guide gets you to a departure gate faster.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: When booking, note your request for a recently refurbished room and inspect before unpacking — the front desk will swap you without fuss. The tunnel walk is faster if you are travelling light; the shuttle is the better option with heavy luggage.

entries.storyHtml: Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport is the newest hotel in this guide, having opened in late 2023. That means every room is genuinely fresh — no worn carpet, no faded fixtures — and cleanliness has earned a 9.5 on Booking.com, the highest in this set. At roughly 3 km and 8 minutes from the airport, the free 24-hour shuttle runs in both directions, but you need to arrange it in advance by phone. Rates sit noticeably above The Park Nine (same distance, similar journey time) so the Marriott brand loyalty and the guarantee of a brand-new room are the deciding factors here. Check-in can queue up during peak hours — confirm your outbound shuttle time at the desk the moment you arrive.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book the shuttle in advance at +66 2 780 3588, stating your flight time. Reconfirm the return trip time at check-in — do not leave it until the morning. If you want to use the ARL into Bangkok, ask the hotel for a drop-off at Lat Krabang station (~4.4 km away).

entries.addr: 599-599/1 Lat Krabang Road, Lat Krabang, Bangkok
entries.storyHtml: The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi opened in 2017 in the Lat Krabang neighbourhood, 3 km from the airport. Its standout feature is a free 8-seater Wi-Fi shuttle that departs every hour around the clock from Gate 5, Level 2 — if you land at 2 AM, a bus is still waiting, which is exactly why repeat guests cite the shuttle as the main reason they come back. The chlorine-free saltwater pool beside a century-old canal earns consistent raves, and room cleanliness scores 9.2 with comfort at 9.3. The only real caveats are noise in road-facing rooms from late-night motorbikes and the absence of any walkable transit link — this hotel is purpose-built for airport stopovers, not city exploration.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Email reservation@theparknine.com with your flight time to reserve a shuttle seat (capacity is 8 per run). If you are sensitive to noise, request a canal-facing or garden-side room. Robinson Lifestyle shopping centre is a 5-minute walk across the road for cheaper food and supplies than in-hotel options.
pros: Free shuttle every 60 min, 24/7 — guests confirm it runs even in the small hours

entries.storyHtml: Siam Mandarina Hotel has been open since 1995 and holds 4,421 verified reviews on Booking.com — more than any other property in this guide. Its staff score of 9.1 is the highest of all seven hotels, a testament to a team that has been refining airport-hotel service for three decades. The single detail that draws pre-dawn travellers here is Crystal Restaurant opening at 4 AM, paired with a free hourly shuttle running all night. The honest note: the building is 25+ years old, not all areas have been renovated, and at 11 km it is the furthest of the Racha Thewa cluster from the airport. But if a hot meal at 4 AM and a staff team that knows airport rhythms cold are your priorities, the review count speaks for itself.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The hotel shuttle meets you at Exit 5, Level 2 with a staff member holding a sign — departs every hour. Request a garden-view room for the quietest sleep; the airport-view rooms have an interesting runway sight line but runway lights are visible at night. Free parking for 100 cars makes this the best choice if you are driving to the airport.

entries.storyHtml: Best Western Premier Amaranth Suvarnabhumi Airport is a 278-room 4-star on Kingkaew Road, explicitly designed for passengers arriving late or departing early. The free hourly shuttle runs from 05:00 to 02:00, meeting guests at Gate 5 Exit B where a staff member waits with a sign — reviewers consistently praise the pick-up as punctual and well-organised. Bua Chompoo restaurant is open 24 hours, ensuring a meal is always available whatever your flight schedule. The honest caveats: the pool closes at 19:00 so evening arrivals may miss it, and some balcony rooms face an industrial view on the Kingkaew Road side. Request a non-road-facing room at booking if view matters to you.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Provide your flight details in advance and reconfirm your outbound shuttle time at check-in — do not assume the bus will appear without prior notice. The meeting point at the airport is Gate 5 Exit B. Deluxe Plus rooms on Floor 7 include Executive Lounge access, which makes sense if you are staying multiple nights.

entries.storyHtml: Sinsuvarn Airport Suite is an 88-room 3-star on Soi Lat Krabang 30, opened in 2009. It is the best-reviewed 3-star option in this guide, with 1,803 Trip.com ratings, and its core sell is a completely free, 24-hour airport shuttle running in both directions on a roughly 7 km route that reviewers consistently describe as punctual. For 900 THB a night you also get an outdoor pool, Thai massage, breakfast and free parking — a rare combination at this price near an international airport. The honest caveats: the building is over 15 years old and some rooms show their age, with reports of musty pipes or noisy air-con units. More practically, the lift stops between floors — guests must walk up or down half a flight of stairs, which is a genuine inconvenience with heavy luggage.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Call the hotel with your flight details so they can time the shuttle correctly. Ask for a recently updated room at booking. The between-floor lift stop is the most common complaint — if you have mobility issues or heavy bags, mention it in advance and ask for a low-floor room.

entries.storyHtml: Cozy Blu Suvarnabhumi is a 154-room 3-star in Racha Thewa, the furthest hotel from the airport in this guide at approximately 10 km. Its genuine strengths are a free breakfast buffet that reviewers describe as unexpectedly generous for the price point, and a clean outdoor pool. However, you need to read the shuttle terms before booking: the free shuttle runs only 4 times per day and only in one direction — from the airport to the hotel (departures approximately 08:30, 11:00, 14:00, 16:00). If you land outside those windows, the on-demand shuttle costs 750 THB per car around the clock. Some rooms also pick up noise from a nearby bar — light sleepers should request a room away from that side.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The 4 free shuttle runs go from the airport to the hotel only — they do not pick you up from the hotel to take you to the airport. If your flight departs and you need a hotel-to-airport run, book the 750 THB on-demand service in advance. Pick up food and supplies at the airport before leaving — there is no convenience store near the hotel. Do not miss free breakfast; it closes at 10:00 AM.

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and may vary by date and season — compare across all three sites before booking. Airport shuttle terms differ significantly across properties: always-free 24/7 (Hyatt, Park Nine, Sinsuvarn, Siam Mandarina) is not the same as time-limited free (Amaranth 05:00–02:00) or direction-limited free (Cozy Blu — airport to hotel only, 4 runs/day). Ratings and details in this guide are derived from verified guest reviews; we did not stay in-person at these properties. Hyatt Regency, Siam Mandarina, Amaranth and Cozy Blu are in Samut Prakan province (Bang Phli district). Article by ThailandAddict.com — Explore Thailand Like a Local.
faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions About Hotels Near Suvarnabhumi Airport

faq.q: Which hotel in this guide is closest to Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport is the closest — it is the airport's only official hotel, connected to the departure hall by a 300-metre underground tunnel, with a free shuttle for guests who prefer to ride. Next are Courtyard by Marriott and The Park Nine Hotel, both roughly 3 km or 8 minutes away with free 24-hour shuttles. The furthest in this guide is Cozy Blu at approximately 10 km / 18 minutes.

faq.q: Which airport shuttles are truly free at Suvarnabhumi Airport hotels?
faq.a: The terms vary considerably — read each carefully before you book. Free 24 hours, both directions: Hyatt Regency (tunnel + shuttle), The Park Nine (every 60 min, Gate 5 Level 2), Sinsuvarn Airport Suite, Siam Mandarina (every 60 min, Exit 5 Level 2). Free during limited hours: Best Western Amaranth (05:00–02:00, advance booking required, Gate 5 Exit B), Courtyard Marriott (24/7 but must phone ahead). Free in one direction only: Cozy Blu (airport to hotel only, ~4 runs/day at 08:30, 11:00, 14:00, 16:00 — hotel to airport costs 750 THB/car).

faq.q: I have a very early flight or a very late arrival. Which hotel handles that best?
faq.a: It depends on your budget. Zero time risk: Hyatt Regency 3,800 THB/night — tunnel walk to the terminal, 24-hr check-in/out, breakfast from 3 AM. Mid-range: The Park Nine 1,800 THB or Courtyard Marriott 4,500 THB — both 3 km away with free all-night shuttles. Need a 4 AM meal: Siam Mandarina 2,200 THB — Crystal Restaurant opens at 4 AM. Tightest budget: Sinsuvarn Airport Suite 900 THB — free shuttle 24/7 in both directions.

faq.q: Can I use the Airport Rail Link (ARL) to get to these hotels from central Bangkok?
faq.a: Yes. The ARL departs from Suvarnabhumi Airport basement, stopping at Lat Krabang, then running to Phaya Thai (where you connect to the BTS Skytrain) in about 30 minutes. Hyatt Regency is a 5-minute walk from the in-airport ARL station. Courtyard Marriott and Park Nine Hotel are ~4.4 km from Lat Krabang station — ask the hotel for a drop-off or pick-up there. Hotels in the Racha Thewa–Bang Phli zone (Amaranth, Siam Mandarina, Cozy Blu) are 10–15 km from Lat Krabang station — use the hotel shuttle or a taxi instead.

faq.q: What is the best hotel near Suvarnabhumi Airport for under 2,000 THB per night?
faq.a: The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi at 1,800 THB is the best option in this bracket — 3 km / 8 minutes from the airport, free shuttle every hour around the clock, score 8.9, saltwater pool and included breakfast. If your budget is under 1,000 THB, Sinsuvarn Airport Suite and Cozy Blu both start at 900 THB with pools and included breakfast — Sinsuvarn has the more convenient 24-hr free shuttle in both directions.

faq.q: Which hotels near Suvarnabhumi Airport have free parking for self-drive travellers?
faq.a: Siam Mandarina Hotel offers free parking for 100 cars and is the best choice for self-drive airport drop-offs. Sinsuvarn Airport Suite, Cozy Blu Suvarnabhumi, The Park Nine Hotel and Best Western Amaranth also provide free parking. Courtyard by Marriott has a free underground car park. For Hyatt Regency (on-airport location), ask about parking charges in advance as rates may apply.
